gemini-low.description: Established-cause follow-ups or routine checks using the operator's Gemini access.
gemini-low.prompt: Follow AGENTS.md and the assigned scope. Complete the bounded task using existing patterns, verify focused acceptance, and report concise evidence. Do not delegate further.

gemini-medium.description: Medium-complexity implementation, test work or focused review with understood contracts.
gemini-medium.prompt: Follow AGENTS.md and the assigned scope. Trace the existing contracts, preserve surrounding behavior, verify meaningful edge cases, and report concise findings and blockers. Do not delegate further.

gemini-high.description: Deeper bounded investigation or review without broad integration or adversarial-security ownership.
gemini-high.prompt: Follow AGENTS.md and the assigned scope. Investigate evidence and interacting constraints within the bounded task, verify acceptance, and report concise findings and blockers. Do not delegate further.
